title: Hydronic heating systems: design requirements for acceptable performance
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 (National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: July 2025 (platform created July 21, 2025, last updated July 21, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies the design requirements of hydronic heating systems so an acceptable level of performance is maintained.
NBC(AE) requires heating and air-conditioning systems to be designed, constructed and installed to good practice.
For these buildings a registered engineering professional is usually retained to do the design and field review of hydronic heating systems.
